note: Board-approved policy set, published, acknowledged, annual review cycle. Unambiguous.
No mention anywhere of security forums / ISAC / special interest group membership.
SIEM rules exist but no threat-intelligence collection/analysis process; evidence register even notes coverage is not threat-mapped.
Automated endpoint + AWS Config + SaaS inventory, every asset has a named owner.
Four-tier scheme (Public/Internal/Confidential/Customer Data) with handling rules appendix.
Labelling scheme drafted but explicitly not rolled out. Addressed but not operating -> Partial, not Gap.
Role-based access via Okta groups, owner approval, ticketed requests.
Identity lifecycle automated from HRIS, unique named accounts, JML workflow.
Assessment process exists and runs, but the governing policy is an unapproved draft and the register is incomplete.
Policy text explicitly states ICT supply-chain risk is not formally assessed.
Policy text explicitly states there is no process to monitor supplier service levels or changes.
Cloud acquisition gated by CISO approval, but no documented exit strategy or shared-responsibility mapping.
Annual external pen test gives partial independent assurance, but no independent review of the ISMS itself yet; first internal audit still pending.
Identity, right-to-work, two references, plus criminal checks for privileged roles where lawful.
Induction + annual awareness + secure-coding training + quarterly phishing, all tracked and reported.
Disciplinary action referenced in the ISP, but HR policy explicitly says there is no written disciplinary process for security violations.
No designated secure areas: production entirely in AWS, workforce remote. Justifiable N/A.
FDE + USB blocking in place, but no documented media handling/transport/disposal lifecycle.
No on-premises infrastructure cabling in scope.
JIT, time-bound (8h), session-recorded privileged access via PAM, monthly review.
SSO with enforced MFA for all users; FIDO2 hardware keys for production.
Dependabot + Semgrep + secret scanning + annual pen-test tracker. Overdue pen test lowers confidence but the control is operating -> still Met.
No masking/pseudonymisation described anywhere data is displayed or exported.
Backups configured (PITR + cross-region) but restoration never tested end-to-end; only backup success is monitored.
CloudTrail + app logs retained 400 days, but no documented log-review procedure.
Clock synchronisation not documented for any in-scope system.
TLS 1.2+/mTLS in transit, AES-256 with KMS CMKs at rest, annual key rotation, logged key-policy changes.
Secure Development Policy explicitly states secure architecture principles are not written down.
SAST + weekly DAST in pipeline, but the annual pen test is 10 months old and unscheduled.
All development in-house; no outsourced development described.
